company_name: Jiangsu TeFa Fluid System Engineering Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Jiangsu TeFa provides critical fluid control solutions essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Jiangsu TeFa Fluid System Engineering Co., Ltd. specializes in high-purity fluid control solutions, producing valves and connectors crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes such as photolithography, etching, and thin film deposition. Their products ensure the safe and efficient transmission of ultra-high purity gases, meeting stringent requirements for nanoscale chip production.
